name: india-einvoice
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Indian GST e-invoicing in FY 2026-27, the Invoice Reference Number (IRN), the Invoice Registration Portal (IRP), or rule 48(4) of the CGST Rules. Trigger on phrases like e-invoice India, IRN, IRP, einvoice1.gst.gov.in, e-invoicing threshold, five crore e-invoicing, QR code on GST invoice, dynamic QR B2C, INV-01 JSON, e-invoice exemption SEZ bank insurer, invoice without IRN, e-invoice penalty, or any question about generating, validating or archiving GST e-invoices. It covers who must comply (aggregate turnover over five crore rupees in any year from 2017-18, from 1 August 2023), excluded classes, the JSON schema fields, GstRt values from 22 September 2025, validation, archiving for seventy-two months, penalties under sections 122 and 125, and links to GSTR-1 and e-way bills. Tier 2, not reviewed by an accountant.
